# Teak — LLM context pack

> Teak is a Zig-native GUI framework: The Elm Architecture (TEA) for state
> plus a flat command-buffer renderer (wgpu-native on desktop, WebGPU on
> web). It is a NOVEL framework, not a port of React/Flutter/SwiftUI —
> governed by docs/HARDLINE.md. This file is the whole public API in one
> read; an agent building an app on Teak should be able to work from this
> file plus docs/cookbook.md alone.

<!--
  llms.txt is HAND-CURATED and AUDIT-ENFORCED.
  - Hand-curated: prose, signatures, and grouping are written by a human/agent,
    not generated. Keep signatures grep-accurate against src/*.zig.
  - Audit-enforced: `zig build audit` runs a rule that extracts every
    `pub const NAME` re-export from src/teak.zig and fails if any NAME is
    absent from this file (rule: "llms.txt lists every src/teak.zig re-export"
    in tools/audit.zig).
  TO UPDATE: when you add/rename a `pub const` in src/teak.zig, add the new
  name here — put it in the "Public API reference" section with its real
  signature and a one-clause purpose. Re-run `zig build audit` until green.
  Requires Zig 0.17.0+.
-->

## The core loop

```
Model ─view()─▶ []Cmd ─layout─▶ []Rect ─render─▶ pixels
                  ▲
   mouse/key ─hit_test─▶ Msg ─update─▶ Model'
```

Every arrow is a plain function call — no globals, no event bus, no
singletons. `view` emits a flat `[]Cmd` (tagged unions) into a per-frame
arena. Layout, hit-test, and render are three independent linear passes
over that same buffer. Input maps back to a `Msg` embedded in the Cmd;
`update` is the only place `Model` mutates. Hit-test runs against the
PREVIOUS frame's cmds/rects (one-frame latency, imperceptible).

Adding a feature is four mechanical steps: (1) add a field to `Model`,
(2) add a variant to `Msg`, (3) add a switch arm to `update`, (4) add
`cb.*` calls in `view`. The exhaustive switch makes step 3 un-skippable.

## HARDLINE — what you MUST and MUST NOT do

These are non-negotiable (docs/HARDLINE.md). Drift = accidentally rebuilding
someone else's paradigm. When a change bumps HARDLINE, the change yields.

### §1 Core invariants
1. **All app state lives in `Model`.** No hidden retained widget state —
   cursor positions, scroll offsets, focus field, selection: explicit fields.
2. **Every state transition is a `Msg` variant.** The switch in `update` is
   the only place `Model` changes.
3. **`view` is a pure function `Model → []Cmd`.** No side effects, no I/O,
   no wall-clock reads, no allocation outside the per-frame arena, no
   importing `platform/*` or `gpu/*`.
4. **Layout, hit-test, render are independent passes** over `[]Cmd`+`[]Rect`.
   No shared mutable state; each pass is replaceable in isolation.
5. **Per-frame data is arena-allocated and bulk-freed.** No per-widget
   alloc/free. Two arenas alternate.

### §3 Forbidden patterns (reject these)
- Widget-internal `static`/module-`var` state keyed by widget identity.
- Function-pointer-plus-context callbacks smuggled onto `Cmd`. Cmds carry
  DATA (labels, styles, `Msg` values), never `*const fn`.
- ID hashing for widget identity. Hit-test/layout key off cmd INDEX;
  persistent identity (focus across reorders) goes on `Model` as a field.
- Virtual DOM diffing / reconcilers / keyed trees. We diff flat buffers.
- Fine-grained reactive signals. Observers are the next frame's `view`.
- Per-widget lifecycle hooks (`onMount`/`onUnmount`). Host-level
  `init`/`frame`/`resize`/`cleanup` are allowed (escape hatch 4).
- Components importing `platform/*` or `gpu/*`. Dependency arrow points in.
- Conditional compilation (`builtin.os.tag`, `@import("builtin")`) in
  `src/{core,layout,input,render}/*`. Platform branching lives in
  `platform/*`/`gpu/*` only.
- A `std.mem.Allocator` parameter on `view()` — the arena reaches it via
  `CmdBuffer`. Reading wall-clock time in `view()`.
- Leaking platform handle types (HWND, wgpu, zunk handles) into the
  framework API.

### §2 Deliberate escape hatches (the only sanctioned breaks)
1. Comptime component stitching (`Components`, `ComponentList`).
2. `TransientState` — presentation-only hover/press/focus, host-written,
   render-only, safely losable.
3. Flat-buffer + fixed-depth-stack layout (no tree recursion).
4. Host layer — window/GPU/input mutable state, only in `platform/*`+`gpu/*`,
   behind `validateHost`/`validateGpu`; `teak.run` orchestrates it.
5. Overlay z-layer (`push_overlay`/`pop_overlay`) — exactly two z-levels.
6. Subscriptions (`Sub`) — declarative, data-only timers.

## The App contract (`teak.run`)

You write an `App` struct (a Zig file works — `@This()` is the struct) and
call `teak.run(App, gpa, &host, &gpu, opts)`. Teak owns the window loop.

### Required decls
```zig
pub const Model = struct { ... };            // default-init'able, or pub fn init() Model
pub const Msg   = union(enum) { ... };       // tagged union
pub fn update(m: *Model, msg: Msg) void;     // the only mutation site
pub fn view(m: *const Model, cb: *CmdBuffer(Msg)) void;   // pure; cb passed as anytype in practice
```

### Optional decls — detected at comptime via `@hasDecl`; add only what you need
```zig
pub fn keyCharMsg(*const Model, u8) ?Msg              // typed character → Msg
pub fn keySpecialMsg(*const Model, SpecialKey) ?Msg   // arrows/backspace/etc → Msg
pub fn keyNeedsClipboard(SpecialKey) bool             // pairs with handleClipboard
pub fn handleClipboard(*Model, SpecialKey, Clipboard) void   // cut/copy/paste policy
pub fn wheelMsg(*const Model, f32) ?Msg               // vertical wheel delta → Msg (when no canvas / scroll region took it)
pub fn canvasMsg(*const Model, CanvasEvent) ?Msg      // pointer events over CanvasCmd.pointer canvases and SceneCmd.pointer scenes (shared id space) (see "Pointer events")
pub fn hoverMsg(*const Model, PointerEvent(Msg)) ?Msg     // the interactive widget under the pointer changed (drives Tooltip)
pub fn sliderMsg(*const Model, grab: Msg, value: f32) ?Msg     // a `slider` cmd is dragged (pointer captured); value 0..1; without it a slider is click-only
pub fn contextMsg(*const Model, PointerEvent(Msg)) ?Msg   // right button down; ev.hit = Msg of the widget under the cursor (drives ContextMenu)
pub fn scrollMsg(*const Model, id: u32, dx: f32, dy: f32) ?Msg   // wheel over innermost hovered ScrollStyle.id != 0 region
pub fn scrollLayoutMsg(*const Model, id: u32, viewport_w: f32, viewport_h: f32,
                       content_w: f32, content_h: f32) ?Msg      // id != 0 scroll region: first layout + on size change
pub fn focusedMsg(*const Model) ?Msg                  // focus Msg of focused widget;
                                                      //   enables focus ring + cursor blink
                                                      //   + built-in Tab/Shift+Tab traversal
pub fn submitMsg(*const Model) ?Msg                   // Enter key (precedes keySpecialMsg for Enter)
pub fn themeFor(*const Model) Theme                   // per-frame theme (dark/light toggle)
pub fn windowMsg(*const Model, f32, f32) ?Msg          // window size in logical px: first frame + every resize
pub fn windowTitle(*const Model) ?[]const u8          // dynamic title bar; setTitle only on change
pub fn secondaryWindow(*const Model) ?SecondaryWindowSpec  // 2nd top-level window, open when non-null
pub fn secondaryView(*const Model, *CmdBuffer(Msg)) void   // 2nd window's view (pairs with above)
pub fn secondaryClosedMsg(*const Model) ?Msg          // dispatched when user OS-closes the 2nd window
pub fn subscribe(*const Model) []const Sub(Msg)       // declarative timers; run services them each
                                                      //   frame via runSubs on Host.nowMs() (§2 hatch 6)
pub fn animationMsg(*const Model, dt_ms: u32) ?Msg    // frame time while a Sub.animation_frame is listed
                                                      //   (core/anim.zig; run loop idles when none is listed)
pub fn resources(*const Model) []const Resource       // declarative GPU meshes/images by (key, rev);
                                                      //   run uploads/releases + maps keys to handles (§2 hatch 8)
```
IME composition (`Host.imeState`) is folded into `TransientState` every
frame with no opt-in. A static read-only app is just Model/Msg/update/view.

### RunOptions
```zig
pub const RunOptions = struct {
    clear_color: [4]f32 = .{ 0.08, 0.08, 0.1, 1.0 },  // scene clear each frame
    blink_half_ms: u32 = 500, // caret blink half-period in Host-clock ms (0 = no blink); idle wakes at each toggle
    snapshot_path: ?[]const u8 = null,   // live snapshot sink; TEAK_SNAPSHOT env wins (see below)
};
pub const SecondaryWindowSpec = struct { title: []const u8, width: u32, height: u32 };
```

## Public API reference

Everything below is a `pub const` re-export from `src/teak.zig` (`teak.NAME`).
Namespace submodules also re-exported (`teak.cmd`, `teak.layout`, …):
`cmd component component_list transient text sub theme text_field text_area text_event numeric_field
`cmd component component_list transient text sub anim theme text_field numeric_field
dropdown data_table var_list tree_list debug_overlay snapshot chart table layout scroll_extent hit_test focus keys a11y render
vertex host input_queue gpu runtime`.

### Version (`teak.version`)
`teak.version: []const u8` — library semver, derived from `build.zig.zon` `.version` (plus `+<meta>` when built with
`-Dversion-meta=<meta>`); the single source is documented in docs/VERSIONING.md.

### Commands & CmdBuffer (`teak.cmd` → core/cmd.zig)
```zig
Cmd(comptime Msg: type) type          // tagged union: push_group/pop_group, push_scroll/pop_scroll,
                                       //   push_overlay/pop_overlay, push_virtual_list/pop_virtual_list,
                                       //   text, rich_text, image, button, text_input, checkbox,
                                       //   radio, slider, divider, canvas. Exposes .MsgT.
CmdBuffer(comptime Msg: type) type     // arena-backed cmd list + emitter methods + .theme field.
Direction = enum { vertical, horizontal }
Align = enum { start, center, end, stretch }      // cross-axis placement of a container's children
Justify = enum { start, center, end, space_between }   // main-axis leftover (no flex children)
TextAlign = enum { start, center, end }           // button label / paragraph line placement
Wrap = enum { none, word, char, ellipsis }       // TextCmd.wrap
ParagraphOpts = struct { wrap: Wrap = .word, max_lines: u16 = 0, text_align: TextAlign = .start }
InputVariant = enum { boxed, underline }          // text_input look (underline: 1px rule, 2px focused)
```
Any slice stored on a Cmd (a text label, an option list, chart primitives)
must borrow from `Model` or from `cb.arena.allocator()` — NEVER a stack
buffer. Layout/render read it after `view` returns, so a `bufPrint(&buf,…)`
into a local is a use-after-return.

`CmdBuffer(Msg)` fields: `.theme: Theme` (assign before view; drives un-styled
emitters), `.arena` (per-frame allocator), `.cmds`. Methods:
`init(backing)`, `deinit()`, `reset()`, `setTheme(t) Theme`.
Emitters (all `catch unreachable` on arena OOM):
- text: `text(s)`, `heading(s)`, `textMuted(s)`, `textDanger(s)`, `textMono(s)`,
  `textStyled(s, font, color)`, `mixedText(parts: []const MixedPart)`
- `divider()`, `dividerStyled(DividerStyle)`
- `button(msg, label)`, `buttonStyled(msg, label, ButtonStyle)`, `buttonDisabled(msg, label)`, `buttonStyledDisabled(msg, label, ButtonStyle)`, `buttonStyledUnderlined(msg, label, ButtonStyle, at: ?usize)` (one underlined ASCII char: a mnemonic hint; `ButtonCmd.underline: ?u16`)
- `textInput(focus_msg, content, cursor)`, `textInputStyled(...)`, `textInputDisabled(...)`,
  `textInputSelected(focus_msg, content, cursor, ?selection_anchor, TextInputStyle)`
- `checkbox(msg, checked, label)`, `radio(msg, selected, label)`, `slider(grab_msg, value)`
- `spacer(flex)` — invisible flex filler (empty zero-padding group)
- containers: `pushGroup(GroupStyle)`/`popGroup()`, `pushScroll(ScrollStyle)`/`popScroll()`,
  `pushOverlay(OverlayStyle(Msg))`/`popOverlay()`, `pushVirtualList(VirtualListStyle)`/`popVirtualList()`,
  `pushFormRow(FormRowOpts)`/`popFormRow()`
- `scene3d(SceneCmd(Msg))` — 3D mesh leaf (see "3D scenes" below).
- `image(TextureHandle, ImageStyle)`, `canvas(CanvasStyle, prims)`, `canvasLabeled(...)`,
  `canvasClickable(msg, style, prims, label)`, `canvasInteractive(style, prims, id, label)`,
  `richText(content, spans)`, `richTextStyled(RichTextCmd)`

Style / option structs an app constructs:
```zig
GroupStyle = struct { direction: Direction = .vertical, padding: f32 = 8,
                      pad_x, pad_y: ?f32 = null,           // per-axis override of padding
                      gap: f32 = 8, flex: f32 = 0,         // flex 0 = no growth, >0 = weight (on top of own size)
                      width, height: f32 = 0,              // fixed OUTER size on that axis; 0 = measured
                      min_width, min_height: f32 = 0,      // floor (beats fixed + stretch)
                      align_cross: Align = .start,         // .stretch: every child fills the inner cross extent
                      justify: Justify = .start,           // leftover main-axis space when no child has flex
                      bg: ?[4]f32 = null,
                      border: ?[4]f32 = null, border_width: f32 = 1 }   // border drawn INSIDE the rect
ScrollStyle = struct { direction = .vertical, padding, gap, flex, width, height,
                       align_cross: Align = .start,
                       scroll_x, scroll_y: f32 = 0,
                       id: u32 = 0 }                        // width/height 0 = measured; flex scroll has zero basis;
                                                            //   id != 0 => scrollMsg / scrollLayoutMsg routing
OverlayStyle(Msg) = struct { x, y, width, height, padding = 8, gap = 4,
                       direction = .vertical, align_cross: Align = .start, backdrop: [4]f32 = {0,0,0,0},
                       anchor_x_frac, anchor_y_frac: f32 = 0, modal: bool = false,
                       border: ?[4]f32 = null, border_width: f32 = 1,
                       shadow: ?[4]f32 = null, shadow_offset: [2]f32 = {2,2},   // hard offset shadow
                       backdrop_msg: ?Msg = null }          // modal swallows click-through;
                                                            //   backdrop_msg = click-outside-to-close
VirtualListStyle = struct { direction, total_count: u32, item_extent: f32,
                       visible_start: u32, visible_end: u32, padding, gap }
ImageStyle = struct { width = 64, height = 64, flex: f32 = 0, tint: [4]f32 = {1,1,1,1} }
ImageCmd = struct { handle: TextureHandle, style: ImageStyle }
ButtonStyle = struct { bg, hover_bg, press_bg, fg, disabled_bg, disabled_fg: [4]f32,
                       hover_fg, press_fg: ?[4]f32 = null, border: ?[4]f32 = null, border_width = 1,
                       press_offset_y: f32 = 0, label_align: TextAlign = .start,
                       h_padding: f32 = 8, min_width: f32 = 60, height: f32 = 36, flex: f32 = 0 }
                       // corners are square (no corner_radius: the quad renderer has no rounding)
ButtonCmd(Msg) = struct { msg, label, style, font, disabled: bool = false, underline: ?u16 = null }
TextCmd = struct { content: []const u8, font: FontSpec, color: [4]f32 }
TextInputStyle = struct { bg, fg, border, focus_border, cursor, disabled_bg, disabled_fg,
                       disabled_border, selection_bg: [4]f32, variant: InputVariant = .boxed,
                       border_width: f32 = 2, flex: f32 = 1, min_width: f32 = 120, height: f32 = 28 }  
TextInputCmd(Msg) = struct { focus_msg, content, cursor, selection_anchor: ?usize,
                       style, font, disabled: bool }
CheckboxStyle = struct { box_bg, box_border, check, fg: [4]f32, size = 18, label_gap = 8 }
CheckboxCmd(Msg) = struct { msg, checked, label, style, font }
RadioStyle = struct { box_bg, box_border, dot, fg: [4]f32, size = 18, label_gap = 8 }
RadioCmd(Msg) = struct { msg, selected, label, style, font }
SliderStyle = struct { track_bg, track_fill, thumb: [4]f32, track_height = 6,
                       thumb_size = 16, flex: f32 = 1, min_width: f32 = 120 }
SliderCmd(Msg) = struct { grab_msg, value: f32 = 0, style }   // app computes value from mouse+rect
DividerStyle = struct { thickness: f32 = 1, color: [4]f32 }
CanvasStyle = struct { width = 200, height = 120, flex: f32 = 0, bg: ?[4]f32 = null }
CanvasCmd(Msg) = struct { style, primitives: []const CanvasPrimitive, msg: ?Msg, label,
                          pointer: bool = false, id: u32 = 0 }   // pointer+id => interactive (canvasMsg)
CanvasPrimitive = union(enum) { polyline, filled_rect, hline, vline, marker,
    triangles: struct { verts: []const TriVertex /*x,y,r,g,b,a*/, key: u64 = 0 },       // per-vertex RGBA triangle list
    lines: struct { segs: []const [4]f32, color, thickness, key: u64 = 0 } }            // canvas-local px
// triangles/lines: CPU-clipped to canvas+scroll clip; `key` = content revision for the frame diff
// (same non-zero key+len => treated equal; 0 => bytes compared). Bump it when the batch changes.
CanvasPoint = struct { x: f32, y: f32 }
RichTextSpan = struct { start, end: u32, color: [4]f32, font: FontSpec, bold, italic: bool }
RichTextCmd = struct { content: []const u8, spans: []const RichTextSpan,
                       default_color: [4]f32, default_font: FontSpec }
MixedPart = struct { text: []const u8, font: ?FontSpec = null, color: ?[4]f32 = null,
                     bold, italic: bool = false }   // null → theme body font / text color
FormRowOpts = struct { label, units, validation: []const u8 = "", gap = 8, validation_gap = 4 }
```
Cmd-buffer balance validation (catches unbalanced push/pop):
```zig
validateBalance(cmds) ?BalanceError            // pure O(n); null when balanced
formatBalanceError(err: BalanceError, buf: []u8) []const u8   // one actionable line
BalanceKind = enum { group, scroll, overlay, virtual_list }
BalanceError = struct { tag, open_kind, open_index, close_kind, close_index }
MAX_BALANCE_DEPTH = 32                          // mirrors LayoutEngine's fixed stack
```

### Charts (`teak.chart` → core/chart.zig)
```zig
LineChartOpts = struct { width, height, min, max: f32, padding: f32 = 4,
                         line_color, grid_color: [4]f32, line_thickness: f32 = 2,
                         grid_lines: u32 = 5 }
lineChartPrimitives(arena, series: []const f32, opts: LineChartOpts) []const CanvasPrimitive
```

### Tables (`teak.table` → core/table.zig)
Fixed-column monospace tables: pad/truncate cells to a character width, emit rows as groups of text cmds.
```zig
Table = struct { columns: []const TableColumn, gutter: u8 = 1, ellipsis: []const u8 = "\u{2026}",
                 pub fn header(self, cb, TableRowStyle) void,
                 pub fn row(self, cb, cells: []const []const u8, TableRowStyle) void,
                 pub fn totalChars(self) usize }
TableColumn = struct { title: []const u8 = "", chars: u16, cell_align: CellAlign = .left }
CellAlign = enum { left, right, center }
TableRowStyle = struct { font = mono, color, bg: ?[4]f32 = null, rule: ?[4]f32 = null,
                         pad_x = 4, pad_y = 2, height: f32 = 0 }
fitCell(alloc, text, width: usize, align: CellAlign, ellipsis, trailing: usize) ![]u8
```

### Layout (`teak.layout` → layout/engine.zig)
```zig
Rect = struct { x, y, w, h: f32 = 0, /* +internal fixed_main/flex_total/child_count */ }
LayoutEngine = struct { pub fn doLayout(rects: []Rect, cmds, window_w: f32, window_h: f32,
                        measurer: TextMeasurer) void }   // measure (bottom-up) + position (top-down)
```

### Hit-test & hover (`teak.hit_test` → input/hit_test.zig)
```zig
hitTest(cmds, rects: []const Rect, mouse_x, mouse_y: f32) ?HitResult(Msg)
                                     // HitResult{ index: usize, msg: ?Msg };
                                     //   msg null = modal consumed click, don't fall through
hoverTest(cmds, rects, mouse_x, mouse_y: f32) ?usize      // cmd index under the cursor
canvasLocalPoint(rect: Rect, mouse_x, mouse_y: f32) ?struct { x, y: f32 }   // window→canvas-local
pointerTarget(cmds, rects, x, y) ?PointerTarget           // {index, id}: pointer canvas a press lands on (overlays/modals win)
wheelTarget(cmds, rects, x, y) ?WheelTarget               // innermost pointer canvas | id!=0 scroll region under the cursor
scrollExtent(cmds, rects, scroll_index) ScrollExtent      // teak.scrollExtent: {viewport_w/h, content_w/h} of a push_scroll
sliderValueAt(rect: Rect, mouse_x: f32) f32               // normalized [0,1]
sliderDrag(cmds, rects, press_target: ?usize, mouse_x: f32) ?SliderDrag(Msg)
SliderDrag(Msg) = struct { index: usize, grab_msg: Msg, value: f32 }
```

### Focus traversal (`teak.focus` → input/focus.zig)
```zig
nextFocusable(cmds, current: ?usize) ?usize   // wraps; null only if no focusable widget
prevFocusable(cmds, current: ?usize) ?usize
indexOfFocusMsg(cmds, msg) ?usize             // cmd index whose leaf carries msg (by value) — stable
focusMsgAt(cmds, index: usize) ?Msg           // the Msg the leaf at index would dispatch
```

### Keys (`teak.keys` → input/keys.zig)
```zig
SpecialKey = enum { backspace, delete, left, right, up, down, home, end, page_up, page_down,
                    enter, tab, escape, shift_left, shift_right, shift_up, shift_down,
                    shift_home, shift_end, shift_tab, ctrl_a, ctrl_c, ctrl_x, ctrl_v,
                    ctrl_z, ctrl_y, ctrl_shift_z, ctrl_left, ctrl_right, ctrl_shift_left,
                    ctrl_shift_right, ctrl_home, ctrl_end, ctrl_shift_home, ctrl_shift_end,
                    ctrl_backspace, ctrl_delete, f10, alt_tap }   // f10 / alt_tap (a bare Alt press+release) activate a MenuBar
```

### Accessibility (`teak.a11y` → input/a11y.zig)
```zig
A11yRole = enum { group, scroll, text, rich_text, button, text_input, checkbox, radio,
                  slider, divider, image, canvas, overlay }
A11yNode = struct { role: A11yRole, cmd_index: u32, bounds: Rect, label: []const u8,
                    focused: bool, state: f32, disabled: bool }
buildA11yTree(arena, cmds, rects: []const Rect, focus_index: ?usize) ![]A11yNode
```

### Subscriptions (`teak.sub` → core/sub.zig)
```zig
Sub(Msg) = union(enum) { every: {interval_ms: u32, msg}, at: {deadline_ms: u64, msg}, animation_frame }
runSubs(Msg, subs: []const Sub(Msg), last_frame_ms, now_ms: u64, dispatch: anytype) void
```
App declares `pub fn subscribe(*const Model) []const Sub` (pure). `teak.run`
services it each frame — `runSubs(subscribe(model))` on `Host.nowMs()` — and
dispatches any fired sub as a normal `Msg` through `update` (no second
mutation path). See docs/features/subscriptions.md.
`animation_frame` carries no Msg: while listed, the loop calls the App's
`animationMsg(model, dt_ms) ?Msg` each frame and does not idle-skip.

### Animation (`teak.anim` → core/anim.zig)
```zig
Tween(T)            // plain struct for the Model: still(v), start(target, ms, Ease), advance(dt_ms),
                    //   active(), progress(), value()   (retargeting continues from value())
Ease                // linear in_quad out_quad in_out_quad in_cubic out_cubic in_out_cubic out_back
ease(Ease, t) f32   // eased progress, t clamped to [0,1]
lerp(T, a, b, t) T  // floats/ints/arrays ([4]f32 colours)/vectors/structs of those
```
Frame time is a Msg (HARDLINE: no wall clock in view). See docs/features/animation.md.

### Theme (`teak.theme` → core/theme.zig)
```zig
Theme = struct { palette, text_color, heading_color, muted_color, danger_color, panel_bg: [4]f32,  // required
                 typography, button, text_input, checkbox, radio, slider, divider, card: GroupStyle,
                 field: TextInputStyle (underline);   // all default to their struct defaults
                 // a fully custom Theme is a plain literal; see docs/features/ergonomic-helpers.md
                 tokens: ThemeTokens, button_primary: ButtonStyle (accent call-to-action);
                 pub const dark_default: Theme; pub const light_default: Theme;
                 pub const modern_light: Theme; pub const modern_dark: Theme;   // rounded, soft shadows, indigo accent
                 pub fn fromPalette(p: Palette) Theme;  pub fn fromPaletteTokens(p: Palette, t: ThemeTokens) Theme }
ThemeTokens = struct { radius_sm, radius_md, radius_lg, border_width: f32, space: [5]f32 /*xs..xl*/,
                       elevation: [4]?Shadow /*steps 0..3*/; pub fn radii(Size) Radii; pub fn shadowAt(level: u2) ?Shadow }
                       // default = retro (square, no soft shadows); theme.modern_tokens = rounded + soft elevations
Palette = struct { bg, bg_panel, bg_sunken, bg_raised, bg_hover, bg_press, fg, fg_muted,
                   accent, danger, border: [4]f32 }
Typography = struct { body, heading, mono, small: FontSpec }
dark_palette: Palette      // built-in dark
light_palette: Palette     // built-in light
```

### Surface decoration: radii, soft shadows, gradients (`core/surface.zig`, drawn by `render/sdf.zig`)
```zig
Radii = struct { tl, tr, br, bl: f32 = 0; pub fn all(r) Radii; top(r); bottom(r) }     // clamped to half the short side
Shadow = struct { dx: f32 = 0, dy: f32 = 2, blur: f32 = 8, spread: f32 = 0, color: [4]f32 }  // CSS box-shadow, outside only
Gradient = struct { from, to: [4]f32, kind: .linear | .radial, angle_deg: f32 = 180 /*CSS: 90 = left to right*/;
                    pub fn vertical(from, to); horizontal(from, to) }
// fields: GroupStyle / ButtonStyle { radius: Radii, gradient: ?Gradient, soft_shadow: ?Shadow }, TextInputStyle.radius,
//         OverlayStyle { radius, soft_shadow } (the hard retro `shadow` is separate), Theme.tokens
```
A rect that sets none of these draws as plain solid quads, pixel for pixel as before. With any of them it is ONE SDF quad in the same
vertex stream (painter's order kept): anti-aliased edges (one device pixel at any DPR), per-corner radii, an inside border stroke that
follows the corners, a two-stop gradient, a Gaussian-blurred shadow. Not covered: rounded clipping of scroll regions, images and canvas
primitives (they stay rectangular).

### Text components (`teak.text_field`, `teak.numeric_field`, `teak.dropdown`)
```zig
TextField(comptime capacity: usize) type   // component (Model/Msg/update/view); Msg = focus,
                                            //   char:u8 (UTF-8 bytes assembled atomically), backspace, delete,
                                            //   cursor_left/right, select_left/right/all/none, home/end/select_home/
                                            //   select_end, word_left/right/select_word_*, delete_word_left/right,
                                            //   undo/redo, replace_selection:[]const u8
                                            //   Model = Editor(capacity, undo_bytes): fields len/cursor/selection_anchor,
                                            //   content()/selectionText()/hasSelection()
textFieldChar(comptime AppMsg, comptime field_name: []const u8, c: u8) AppMsg
textFieldSpecial(comptime AppMsg, comptime field_name, key: SpecialKey) ?AppMsg
textFieldReplaceSelection(comptime AppMsg, comptime field_name, bytes: []const u8) AppMsg
keyNeedsClipboard(key: SpecialKey) bool     // true for ctrl_c/ctrl_x/ctrl_v

NumericField(comptime config: NumericConfig) type   // TextField + parse/validate; adds
                                                     //   value()?f64, isValid(), content(), formatValue()
NumericConfig = struct { capacity: usize = 16, min: ?f64 = null, max: ?f64 = null,
                         precision: u8 = 2, invalid_message: []const u8 = "invalid number" }

Dropdown(comptime cap: usize) type          // closed button + open overlay list; Msg = toggle,
                                            //   close, select:usize, scroll_by, highlight.
                                            //   Real view is viewWith(model, cb, options, msgs, opts)
DropdownViewOpts = struct { list_x, list_y: f32 = 0, list_width: f32 = 200,
                            list_max_height: f32 = 320, max_visible: usize = 0 }
```

### Pointer events on canvases (`teak.pointer` -> core/pointer.zig)
Delivered by `teak.run` / `Runtime` through `canvasMsg`; semantics in docs/features/canvas.md.
```zig
Buttons = packed struct(u8) { left, middle, right: bool }   // held buttons; .any()
Modifiers = packed struct(u8) { shift, ctrl, alt, meta: bool }
Button = enum { none, left, middle, right }
CanvasEventKind = enum { down, move, up, wheel, leave, layout }   // layout = first layout / size change
CanvasEvent = struct { id: u32, kind: CanvasEventKind, x, y, dx, dy: f32, button: Button,
                       buttons: Buttons, mods: Modifiers, w, h: f32 }  // canvas-local px
```
```zig
Box = struct { x, y, w, h: f32 }
PointerEvent(Msg) = struct { x, y: f32, hit: ?Msg /*click Msg of the widget under the cursor; its identity*/,
                             box: Box /*that widget's rect, previous frame*/, mods: Modifiers, now_ms: u64 }
```
`PointerEvent` is what the `hoverMsg` / `contextMsg` App hooks receive (see Widgets below).
An interactive canvas is `cb.canvasInteractive(style, prims, id, label)` (`CanvasCmd.pointer = true`, `id != 0`);
its events arrive through `pub fn canvasMsg(*const Model, CanvasEvent) ?Msg`. `down` starts a capture (move/up keep
going to that canvas, even off its rect, until all buttons release); `move` while hovering; a wheel over it is a
`wheel` event INSTEAD of `wheelMsg`/`scrollMsg`; `leave` when the cursor exits with no capture; `layout` (w/h) on
first layout and whenever its size changes. Overlays and modals in front of a canvas win. Wheel routing, innermost
first: pointer canvas -> `ScrollStyle.id != 0` region (`scrollMsg`) -> `wheelMsg`. `scrollLayoutMsg` reports each
id-bearing scroll region's viewport + content size (`teak.scrollExtent`) so apps can clamp offsets / draw scrollbars.

### Declarative effects (`teak.effects` -> core/effects.zig; HARDLINE hatch 7, sibling of Sub; docs/features/effects.md)
```zig
// App decls: pub fn effects(*const Model) []const Effect;  pub fn effectMsg(*const Model, EffectResult) ?Msg
// (effectMsg alone = an app that only wants dropped images / pasted text)
Effect = union(enum) { http: HttpRequest, download: Download, open_file: OpenFile,
                       write_clipboard: WriteClipboard, storage_set: StorageSet,
                       storage_get: StorageGet, clock: ClockRequest, query_param: QueryParam }
    // every payload has `id: u32` (yours, unique per request); Effect.id(), Effect.wantsResult()
HttpRequest = struct { id: u32, method: HttpMethod, url, headers: []const Header, body: []const u8, timeout_ms: u32 }
HttpResult = struct { id, status: u16 /*0 = transport failure*/, body, err }
Download = struct { id, name, mime, bytes }      OpenFile = struct { id, accept: []const u8 /* ".json,image/*" */ }
StorageSet = struct { id, key, value /* "" deletes */ }   StorageGet = struct { id, key }
QueryParam = struct { id, name }   // web ?name=v ; native --name=v argv or env TEAK_<NAME_UPPER>
EffectResult = union(enum) { http: HttpResult, file_opened: {id,name,mime,bytes}, file_cancelled: {id},
                             downloaded: {id,ok}, storage_value: {id, value: ?[]const u8},
                             query_value: {id, value: ?[]const u8}, clock: {id, unix_ms: i64, utc_offset_min: i32},
                             dropped: Drop, pasted_text: {text} }
Drop = struct { kind: DropKind /*file|image|text*/, name, mime, bytes,
                width: u32 = 0, height: u32 = 0,                        // images: size of the encoded bytes
                thumb_rgba: []const u8 = "", thumb_w: u32 = 0, thumb_h: u32 = 0 }  // images: <=64 px RGBA8 preview
Header = struct { name, value }     HttpMethod = enum { get, post, put, delete }
EffectSubmit = enum { accepted, busy, unsupported }   // Host.submit's answer
// Host (optional pair, validateHost): submit(*Host, Effect) EffectSubmit ; pollEffectResults(*Host, []EffectResult) usize
```
`run` hands each listed `id` to `Host.submit` once, leaves it alone while it stays listed, forgets it when it is
delisted (a late result for an unlisted id is dropped = cancellation). Results flow `effectMsg` -> `update`
(`last_msg` names them). Effect slices live for the `submit` call; result slices until the `update` returns.
Keep the request in `Model` (`effects()` returns a slice of it). 32 ids at once.
Native: HTTP on worker threads, storage under `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/teak/<app>/` (`RunOptions.app_name` or the window title), downloads to `$TEAK_OUT`,
`TEAK_OPEN=path` feeds `open_file`, `query_param` reads `--name=value` / `TEAK_<NAME>`.

### Fonts (docs/features/text.md)
```zig
FontSpec = struct { size_px: f32 = 14 /* em size, like CSS px */, family: FontFamily = .sans,
                    weight: FontWeight = .regular /* regular 400, medium 500, bold 700 */, letter_spacing: f32 = 0 }
// web (build.zig):  teak.linkWebWgpu(b, exe, .{ .fonts = &.{ .{ .family = "IBM Plex Mono", .weight = 400,
//                       .path = b.path("assets/IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf"), .slot = .mono /* default */ }, ... } })
//                   -> copied to dist/fonts/, @font-face, app starts after document.fonts.load; slot text uses "<family>", monospace
// native Linux:     try host.registerFont(.mono, .bold, @embedFile("plex-Bold"));   // <= 3 weights per family; Gpu shares the table
```

### Components composition (`teak.component`, `teak.component_list`)
```zig
Components(comptime components: anytype, comptime AppLevel: ?type) type
    // synthesizes Model/Msg/update/view from a struct of components; AppLevel adds
    // app-wide state + Msgs (null for none). e.g.
    // teak.Components(.{ .counter = Counter, .name = teak.TextField(64) }, AppLevel)
validateComponent(comptime T: type) void    // comptime contract check (Model/Msg/update/view shape)
ComponentList(comptime Child: type, comptime capacity: usize) type
    // dynamic homogeneous list; Msg = clear, append, remove_at, insert_at, swap, child.
    // Stable u64 keys per item (focus survives reorder). Helpers: keyAt, indexOfKey,
    // childMsg, childAt, focusedMsgForKey, focusedMsgFor.
```
A component is any type with `pub const Model`/`Msg` + `pub fn update(*Model, Msg) void`
+ `pub fn view(*const Model, cb: anytype, msgs: anytype) void`.

SnapshotOptions = struct { transient: ?*const TransientState = null, header: ?SnapshotHeader = null }

writeSnapshot(writer, cmds, rects: []const Rect, opts) !void   // one grep-able line per cmd

### Render (`teak.render`, `teak.vertex`)
```zig
buildFrame(verts, text_draws, image_draws, scene_draws, scene_items: *std.ArrayList(...), alloc, cmds, rects,
           transient: TransientState, measurer: TextMeasurer) OverlaySplit   // what teak.run uses
OverlaySplit = struct { verts, text, images, scenes: u32 }   // counts the BASE layer produced = where the overlay starts
buildVertices(verts, text_draws, image_draws, alloc, cmds, rects, transient, measurer) void  // = buildFrame, scenes skipped
ResourceTable = struct { sync(self, gpu, []const Resource) bool /*changed*/, deinit(self, gpu), handleOf(kind, key) u32 }
stageDraws(gpu, ?*ResourceTable, images: []ImageDraw, scenes: []SceneDraw, items: []SceneItem) void  // remap keys (incl. item keys), uploadImages, renderScenes
                                      // (hand-written web loops call these; teak.run does it for you)
ImageDraw = struct { rect_x, rect_y, rect_w, rect_h: f32, handle: TextureHandle,
                     tint: [4]f32, clip_x, clip_y, clip_w, clip_h: f32 }
Vertex = extern struct { x, y, r, g, b, a, u, v: f32 }
emitQuad(verts, alloc, rect: Rect, color: [4]f32) void
emitQuadCorners(verts, alloc, c0, c1, c2, c3: [2]f32, color: [4]f32) void   // rotated quads
```

### 3D scenes (`teak.scene` → core/scene.zig; see docs/features/scene3d.md)
```zig
MeshHandle = u32;  MESH_HANDLE_NONE: MeshHandle = 0
MeshVertex = extern struct { pos: [3]f32, normal: [3]f32, color: [4]f32 }   // 40 B
LineVertex = extern struct { pos: [3]f32, color: [4]f32 }                   // 28 B
MeshData = struct { vertices: []const MeshVertex = &.{}, indices: []const u32 = &.{},
                    lines: []const LineVertex = &.{} /* consecutive pairs = segments */;
                    pub fn validate(self) error{IndexOutOfRange,PartialTriangle}!void }
Camera = struct { view_proj: [16]f32 /* column-major, WebGPU clip: z 0..1 */ = identity,
                  eye: [3]f32 = .{0,0,0}, light_dir: [3]f32 /* travel dir; zero = headlight */ }
SceneDraw = struct { mesh: MeshHandle, rect_x, rect_y, rect_w, rect_h: f32, clip_x, clip_y, clip_w, clip_h: f32,
                     camera: Camera, clear: [4]f32, edge_color: [4]f32, edge_px: f32 }
```
```zig
SceneStyle = struct { width: f32 = 320, height: f32 = 240, flex: f32 = 0 }
SceneCmd(Msg) = struct { style, mesh: MeshHandle /*or resource key*/, camera: Camera, clear: [4]f32,
                         edge_color: [4]f32, edge_px: f32 = 1.5, key: u64 /*bump with mesh rev*/,
                         id: u32 = 0, pointer: bool = false, msg: ?Msg, label: []const u8 }
Resource = union(enum) { mesh: MeshResource{key,rev,data: MeshData}, image: ImageResource{key,rev,width,height,rgba} }
```
Flat-shaded two-sided lighting (one directional light + ambient), depth-tested, feature lines
as camera-facing pixel-width quads (colour = vertex colour * `edge_color`). The Gpu renders each
`SceneDraw` offscreen, then composites it like an image.

### viewport3d: placed items + scene options (`teak.SceneView`, `SceneItem`; design: docs/features/scene.md)
`cb.viewport3d(.{ .style, .camera, .view = .{ .items = arena_slice, ... }, .clear, .key, .id, .pointer })` is `scene3d` with
`SceneCmd.view` populated; with no items it is the legacy single-mesh scene. A `cut` plane discards the removed half and fills
caps by stencil parity per closed item (hatched, per-item colour) with an exact outline from the CPU mesh copy; `no_cap` items
(open shells) get the outline only. A canvas `layout` event carries the rect's window origin in `x`,`y`.
```zig
SceneItem = struct { mesh: u32 /*resource key*/, transform: [12]f32 /*3x4 rows, identity*/, tint: [4]f32 = white,
                     id: u32 = 0 /*echoed by pick*/, flags: SceneItemFlags{hidden, unlit, no_edges, no_pick, highlight, no_cap},
                     cap_color: [4]f32 = 0 /*section-cap fill; alpha 0 = Cut.cap_color*/ }
SceneView = struct { items: []const SceneItem, grid: ?Grid, gizmo: ?Gizmo, cut: ?Cut /*keeps n.p+d<=0*/,
                     material: enum{lambert,flat}, highlight_color: [4]f32, highlight_mix: f32; pub fn eql }
```
`buildFrame` flattens each scene's visible items into `scene_items` (`SceneDraw.item_first/item_count`); `stageDraws` remaps their
keys to handles; `Gpu.renderScenes(draws, items)` draws them. Snapshot suffix: `items=N grid cut gizmo flat`.

### Scene camera, picking, section cuts (`teak.scene.{Orbit,camera,pick,section,mat}`; design: docs/features/scene.md)
Pure math, no allocation except where noted. Right-handed, column-major, depth 0..1.
```zig
Orbit = struct { target: [3]f32, yaw, pitch: f32 /*clamped +-(pi/2-0.01)*/, dist: f32, up: enum{y,z},
                 projection: Projection /* .{.perspective=.{.fov_y}} | .ortho (half-height = dist*tan(0.35)) */,
                 near_far: ?[2]f32;
                 pub fn setPreset(*Orbit, Preset{front,back,left,right,top,bottom,iso}) void
                 pub fn frame(*Orbit, lo, hi: [3]f32, aspect) void       // fit bounding sphere
                 pub fn toggleProjection(*Orbit) void                     // keeps apparent size at target
                 pub fn onEvent(*Orbit, CanvasEvent, Bindings) bool       // orbit / pan (middle or shift) / wheel zoom-to-cursor
                 pub fn camera(Orbit, w, h: f32, ?Bounds) Camera          // near/far from bounds
                 pub fn eye / basis / halfHeight / rotate / panPx / zoomAt }
Ray = struct { origin, dir: [3]f32 };  Bounds = struct { lo, hi: [3]f32 }
pickRay(Camera, w, h, x, y) Ray            // viewport-local logical px
project(Camera, w, h, p: [3]f32) ?[3]f32   // px + ndc depth; null behind the eye
pick.items(Ray, []const pick.Item, []const pick.MeshRef, pick.Options{cull_back, cut}) ?pick.Hit  // {id,item,triangle,t,point,normal}
pick.Item = struct { mesh: u32, transform: [12]f32 /*3x4 rows*/, id: u32, hidden, no_pick: bool }
pick.MeshRef = struct { key: u32, mesh: MeshData, bvh: ?*const pick.Bvh, bounds: ?Bounds }
pick.Bvh.build(gpa, MeshData) !Bvh;  pick.rayTriangle / pick.rayAabb / pick.nearestBrute
pick.gizmoHit(Orbit, GizmoLayout, w, h, x, y) ?GizmoAxis;  pick.gizmoTips;  GizmoAxis.preset(up) Preset
pick.gizmoLabels(Orbit, GizmoLayout, w, h, origin_x, origin_y, gap_px) [3]GizmoLabel  // X/Y/Z letter centres; pass the canvas `layout` event's x,y as origin for window space
section.outline(gpa, MeshData, transform, plane [nx,ny,nz,d] /*keeps n.p+d<=0*/, *ArrayList(Segment)) !void
section.outlinePositions(gpa, []const Vec3, []const u32, transform, plane, *ArrayList(Segment)) !void  // same, over bare positions
section.chain(gpa, []const Segment) !Loops;  section.isClosed(gpa, MeshData) !bool   // even-edge watertight check
```

### Text measurement (`teak.text` → core/text.zig)
```zig
FontFamily = enum { sans, serif, mono }
FontWeight = enum { regular, medium, bold }
FontSpec = struct { size_px: f32 = 14, family: FontFamily = .sans, weight: FontWeight = .regular,
                    letter_spacing: f32 = 0, snap_advance: ?bool = null }   // px per glyph; snap_advance rounds advances to whole px (null: on for .mono)
DEFAULT_FONT: FontSpec        // sans 14px
TextMetrics = struct { width, height, ascent, descent: f32 }
TextMeasurer = struct { ctx: *anyopaque, measure_fn; pub fn measure(text, font) TextMetrics;
                        pub fn prefixWidth(text, font, byte_prefix: usize) f32 }
ShapedGlyph = extern struct { glyph: u16, face: u16, cluster: u32, x: f32, advance: f32 }  // logical order; sum(advance)==width
ShapeResult = struct { count: usize, width: f32, consumed: usize }   // consumed < text.len only when `out` filled
Shaper = struct { ctx: *anyopaque, shape_fn; pub fn shape(text, font, out: []ShapedGlyph) ShapeResult }
TextureHandle = u32
TEXTURE_HANDLE_NONE: TextureHandle = 0
TextDraw = struct { rect_x, rect_y, rect_w, rect_h, content, font, color, clip_x..clip_h }
monoMeasurer() TextMeasurer    // stateless 10px/byte, 20px line — for headless tests + CLI
```

### Tables & lists at scale (`teak.DataTable`, `teak.VarList`, `teak.TreeList`, `teak.Scroller`)
Virtualized components for 100k-row data (docs/features/tables-at-scale.md). All state in the Model; rows are the app's,
passed as a `src` value; each emits only the visible rows. Wire the hooks `scrollMsg`, `scrollLayoutMsg`, `animationMsg` + `subscribe`.
```zig
Scroller = struct { pos, target, vel, max, smooth_ms = 70, friction_ms = 325 }   // smooth wheel + fling, as Model data
  wheel(dy) / glideTo(y) / jumpTo(y) / fling(px_per_s) / shift(d) /*anchor*/ / setExtent(viewport, content)
  animating() bool  /* list Sub.animation_frame while true */ ;  step(dt_ms)
DataTable(comptime cfg: struct { max_rows = 131072, max_cols = 16 }) type
  Model: n_rows, order/rank (display<->data permutation), sort_col/sort_desc, widths, selection (bitset by DATA row),
         cursor/anchor, focused, mods, sc: Scroller, view_h;  setRows(n) / setColumns(cols) / isSelected(row) / selectedRows(out)
  Msg = union(enum) { sort: u8, grip: {col, dx}, row: u32 /*display idx*/, key: Key, wheel: f32, viewport: {vw,vh,cw,ch}, mods: Modifiers, frame: u32, blur }
  update(model, msg, src)   // src.compare(col: u8, a: u32, b: u32) std.math.Order  (stable index sort); src.cell(arena, col: u8, row: u32) []const u8
  view(model, cb, cols: []const DataTableColumn, src, msgs /*.sort(col) .row(display)*/, ViewOpts{ id, grip_base, row_h = 22, header_h = 26, char_w = 8, ... })
  keyMsg(SpecialKey, mods) ?Msg;  gripMsg(CanvasEvent, grip_base) ?Msg;  charMsg(u8) ?Msg /*type-to-search*/;  searchText(model) []const u8;  reveal(model, display_row)
DataTableColumn = struct { title, width = 120, min_width = 36, cell_align: CellAlign = .left, sortable = true }
VarList(comptime cap: usize) type      // rows of different heights, measured by layout, scroll-anchored
  Model: n, est, h[], prefix[], sc, view_h;  setCount(n, est) / insert(at, h) / remove(at) / rowAt(y) / total()
  Msg = union(enum) { wheel, viewport, measured: {first, count, heights[96]}, frame };  measuredMsg(first, heights) Msg
  view(model, cb, src /* src.row(cb, i) emits ONE child */, ViewOpts{ id, height, ... })
TreeList(comptime cap: usize) type     // preorder nodes + depth; expand/collapse; keyboard
  Model: n_nodes, expanded (bitset), visible[], n_visible, selected, sc;  setNodes(n, src, expand_depth) / rowOf(node)
  Msg = union(enum) { toggle: u32, select: u32, key: Key, wheel, viewport, frame, blur };  update(model, msg, src)  // src.depth(node) u16, src.label(arena, node) []const u8
  view(model, cb, src, msgs /*.toggle(node) .select(node)*/, ViewOpts{ id, row_h = 22, indent = 16, ... });  keyMsg(SpecialKey) ?Msg
// VirtualListStyle gained total_extent / start_offset (variable rows), id (measured-row reports) and align_cross.
// App hooks added: virtualRowsMsg(model, id, first_row, heights: []const f32) ?Msg;  modsMsg(model, mods: Modifiers) ?Msg
```

### TextArea and text events (`teak.TextArea`, `teak.text_area`, `teak.text_event`)
Multi-line editing: `cb.textArea(TextAreaCmd{ focus_msg, id, content, cursor, selection_anchor, scroll_x/y, goal_x,
wrap: Wrap = .word, font, style: TextInputStyle, width, min_width = 120, height = 120, flex, padding = 6, disabled })`
(`cb.textAreaThemed(...)`). Layout sizes it like a canvas; render wraps to the inner box, draws per-line selection,
caret and IME composition, clipped. The runtime turns input over it into `TextEvent`s for the optional hook
`textMsg(*const Model, TextEvent) ?Msg`; the focused area also gets Up/Down/PageUp/PageDown/Home/End (and Shift
variants) as `move` events resolved on the wrapped layout, and its caret rect feeds `Host.setImeSpot` when present.
```zig
TextEventKind = enum { down, drag, up, double_click, triple_click, wheel, move, metrics, leave }
TextEvent = struct { id, kind, index: u32 /*nearest grapheme boundary*/, line: u32, x, y, dx, dy, goal_x, keep_goal,
                     mods, clicks, viewport_w/h, content_w/h, caret_x/y/h }   // metrics fields only for .metrics
TextArea(comptime cap: usize) type   // Model { ed: Editor (multiline), scroll_x/y, viewport/content/caret metrics }
  Msg = union(enum) { focus, char: u8, newline, key: SpecialKey, paste: []const u8, event: TextEvent }
  update(model, msg)   // events: Editor.applyPointer for caret/selection; wheel scrolls; metrics clamp + reveal caret
  eventMsg(ev) / charMsg(c) / pasteMsg(bytes) / keyMsg(SpecialKey) ?Msg
  viewWith(model, cb, .{ .focus = msg }, ViewOpts{ id = 1, width, min_width, height, flex, wrap, padding, style, font, disabled })
Editor.applyPointer(ev) bool          // down / drag / double / triple / move -> caret + selection
text_wrap.resolveNav(text, cursor, goal_x, NavKind, page, font, max_w, mode, m) NavResult{index, goal_x, line}
layout.textAreaInner(rect, ta) Rect;  layout.textAreaWrapWidth(inner, ta) f32
### Combobox (`teak.Combobox` → core/combobox.zig)
Searchable select: text query + filtered modal overlay list (Dropdown-style, zero new Cmds).
```zig
Combobox(comptime cap: usize) type      // cap = query bytes; Model/Msg/update/view + viewWith
  Model = struct { query: TextField(cap).Model, open: bool, selected: ?usize, highlighted: usize, scroll_offset: f32 }
  Msg = union(enum) { focus, close, select: usize /*original option index*/, edit: TextField(cap).Msg,
                      highlight: Highlight, scroll_by: ScrollBy }
  viewWith(model, cb, options: []const []const u8, msgs /*.focus .close .selectMsg(i)*/, opts: ComboboxViewOpts)
  charMsg(u8) Msg;  keyMsg(model, SpecialKey, options, opts) ?Msg;  enterMsg / highlightMsg / scrollByMsg(...)
  shownText(model, options) []const u8
ComboboxViewOpts = struct { list_x, list_y: f32 = 0, list_width: f32 = 200, max_visible: usize = 8,
                            match: Match(.substring|.prefix) = .substring, input_style: ?TextInputStyle = null }
// pure: combobox.matches(query, option, mode) bool, countMatches, nthMatch, ordinalOf, foldCase
```

### Widgets (`teak.widgets` → core/widgets/*.zig; docs/features/widgets.md; zero new Cmd variants)
Each is Model/Msg/update + view helpers in the Dropdown mould; all state in the app's Model.
```zig
widgets.toggle.view(cb, msg, on: bool, label) / viewStyled(cb, msg, on, label, toggle.Style)   // switch (clickable canvas)
widgets.progress: bar(cb, value 0..1, Style{width,height,flex,track_color,fill_color,border_color,block});
  indeterminate(cb, phase: u16, Style); Model{phase}; Msg{tick}; update; TICK_MS; PERIOD   // phase advanced by Sub.every
widgets.tabs: Model{selected, focused}; Msg{select: usize, move: {move: Move, count}, blur}; update;
  viewWith(model, cb, labels: []const []const u8, msgs /*.selectMsg(i)*/, ViewOpts{min_width,height,rule});
  keyMsg(model, SpecialKey, count) ?Msg (Left/Right wrap, Home/End, Escape=blur); moveMsg(Move, count)
widgets.split: Model{ratio, dragging}; Msg{grab, drag: Drag, release, set: f32}; update;
  Opts{orientation(.horizontal|.vertical), width, height, divider, min_a, min_b, id, pane_padding, pane_gap};
  begin(model, cb, opts); divider(model, cb, opts); end(cb);   // emit pane A, divider, pane B, end
  canvasMsg(model, CanvasEvent, opts) ?Msg;  paneA(model, opts) f32;  paneB(model, opts) f32
widgets.tooltip: Model{item, box, deadline, shown}; Msg{hover: Hover, show, hide}; update;
  hoverMsg(comptime AppMsg, PointerEvent(AppMsg), targets: []const AppMsg, delay_ms) Msg;  deadline(model) ?u64 (-> Sub.at);
  view(model, cb, texts: []const []const u8, ViewOpts{window_w, window_h, gap})
widgets.toast.Toast(cap, text_cap): Model{items,len,next_id}; Msg{push: Push{kind,text,ttl}, dismiss: u32, tick, clear};
  update; push(model, Kind, text, ttl_ticks); active(model) bool; viewWith(model, cb, msgs /*.dismissMsg(id)*/, ViewOpts{window_w,window_h,width,margin,gap});
  Kind = enum { info, success, warning, danger };  TICK_MS; default_ttl
widgets.dialog: view(cb, Opts{window_w, window_h, title, message, confirm_label, cancel_label: ?[]const u8, width, danger,
  dismiss_on_backdrop, scrim}, msgs /*.confirm .cancel*/); begin / end (own body between); keyMsg(key, msgs, has_cancel) ?AppMsg
widgets.menu.MenuBar(Action) type: Item (= MenuItem(Action){label "&File" mnemonic, action: ?Action, shortcut, enabled, checked,
    separator, children}; Item.sep); Model{st: State}; Msg{goto: State, close}; update; isActive(model);
    viewWith(model, cb, items, msgs /*.menu(Msg) .run(Action)*/, ViewOpts{x,y,window_w,window_h,top_width,bar_height,panel_w,row_h,cols,bar_bg});
    keyMsg(model, SpecialKey, items, msgs) ?AppMsg (F10/Alt activate; arrows, Enter, Escape); charMsg(model, u8, items, msgs) ?AppMsg (mnemonics)
widgets.menu.ContextMenu(Action) type: Model{x,y,st}; Msg{open_at, goto, close}; openAt(x, y) Msg; isOpen; viewWith / keyMsg / charMsg as MenuBar
widgets.menu.State{active, hot, open, depth, sel[4]}; menu.displayLabel(cb, label); menu.mnemonicIndex(label) ?usize; menu.max_depth; menu.SEP_H
```
Choosing a leaf dispatches `msgs.run(action)`; the app's update also runs `MenuBar.update(&m.bar, .close)`.
Tab traversal (`focus.nextFocusable` / `prevFocusable`) stays inside the topmost modal overlay (dialogs, menus).
`cb.buttonStyledDisabled(msg, label, ButtonStyle)` is a disabled button with an explicit style.

### Editor (`teak.editor` → core/editor.zig)
Fixed-capacity UTF-8 text editor state for the component Model (TextField is a thin wrapper).
Cursor and anchor always sit on grapheme boundaries; invalid UTF-8 tolerated; no op splits a cluster.
```zig
Editor(comptime cap: usize, comptime undo_cap: usize) type   // undo_cap = history bytes (0 = no undo)
  fields: buf, len, cursor, selection_anchor: ?usize, goal_x: ?f32, multiline: bool, undo: UndoLog
  content() / selection() / selectionRange() / hasSelection()
  set(s) / clear() / selectAll() / deselect() / setSelection(a, c) / selectWordAt(i) / moveTo(i, extend)
  move(Move{left,right,home,end,word_left,word_right,doc_start,doc_end}, extend)
  moveLineEdge(.start|.end, extend, font, max_w, mode, m)      // visual-line Home/End via text_wrap
  moveVertical(lines: i32, extend, font, max_w, mode, m)       // Up/Down/Page, sticky goal_x
  insert(bytes) / paste(bytes) / typeByte(u8) / backspace() / delete() / deleteWordLeft() / deleteWordRight()
  undoEdit() bool / redoEdit() bool                            // typed words coalesce; undo.dropped counts overflow
  applyKey(SpecialKey) bool                                    // layout-free keys; false = not handled here
  window(max_cols) Window{start,end,cursor,anchor}             // visible slice of a wide single-line field
UndoLog(rec_cap, byte_cap) type
```

### Unicode, line breaking, wrapping (`teak.unicode`, `teak.linebreak`, `teak.text_wrap`)
Pure, allocation-free, std-only; byte offsets everywhere; invalid UTF-8 tolerated (1 bad byte = 1 unit).
// Wrapped text and shrink (layout passes 2-3 run only when present; see docs/features/layout.md)
cb.paragraph(s) / cb.paragraphStyled(s, font, color, ParagraphOpts{ wrap = .word, max_lines: u16 = 0, text_align }) / cb.textEllipsis(s)
Wrap = enum { none, word, char, ellipsis }          // TextCmd.wrap (default none)
GroupStyle.shrink / ScrollStyle.shrink: f32 = 0      // shrink weight; wrapped text shrinks implicitly
LayoutEngine.doLayoutStats(rects, cmds, w, h, measurer) Stats{ wrap_passes: bool }
```zig
// core/unicode.zig (Unicode 16 tables generated by tools/gen_unicode.zig)
utf8DecodeLossy(bytes, i) Decoded{cp: u21, len: u3}      // bad byte -> U+FFFD, len 1
nextGrapheme(text, i) usize        // end of the UAX#29 cluster starting at i
prevGrapheme(text, i) usize        // start of the cluster containing byte i-1
isGraphemeBoundary(text, i) bool;  snapBackward(text, i) usize;  graphemeCount(text) usize
GraphemeIterator{text, pos}.next() ?[]const u8
wordClass(cp) WordClass(space|word|punct|han);  nextWordBoundary / prevWordBoundary(text, i) usize
wordRangeAt(text, i) Span{start,end}                      // double-click selection
lineBreakClass(cp) Lb;  graphemeBreakClass(cp) Gcb;  isWide(cp) bool
// core/linebreak.zig: UAX#14-lite opportunities (kinsoku, NBSP/WJ, ZWSP, hyphen)
Breaker.init(text, start).next() ?Break{end, kind: soft|hard|end}
// core/text_wrap.zig
Line = struct { start, end, hang, next: u32, width: f32, hard_break, ellipsized: bool }
nextLine(text, start, font, max_w, mode, m) Line;  LineIter.init(text, font, max_w, mode, max_lines, m).next() ?Line
measureWrapped(text, font, max_w, mode, max_lines, m) Measured{w, h, lines}
minContent / maxContent(text, font, m) f32
caretPos(text, index, font, max_w, mode, max_lines, m) Caret{x, y, line}
indexAt(text, x, y, font, max_w, mode, max_lines, m) usize  // inverse of caretPos at grapheme boundaries
```

### Host interface (`teak.host` → platform/host.zig)
Backends live in `platform/{win32,x11,wasm}.zig` — NOT re-exported (web entry points must also declare `pub const std_options: std.Options = .{ .logFn = platform.logFn };` — the default std.log sink does not build on wasm32-freestanding); the build
picks one under the import name `teak-platform-native`.
```zig
InputState = struct { mouse_x, mouse_y: f32,
                      buttons: Buttons,                       // held now (left/middle/right)
                      button_down, button_up: Buttons,        // edges this frame (a fast click sets both)
                      mouse_down, mouse_up: bool,             // left-button edges (== button_down.left / button_up.left)
                      mods: Modifiers,                        // shift/ctrl/alt/meta at the latest event
                      wheel_dx, wheel_dy: f32,                // CSS-style px, + = down/right; web pinch = wheel + mods.ctrl
                      chars: []const u8,                      // UTF-8 text typed this frame (whole code points)
                      keys: []const SpecialKey,               // arrows, Delete/Home/End, Shift+motion, Ctrl+A/C/X/V/Y/Z, Tab, ...
                      resized: bool, width, height: u32 }
InputQueue          // per-window accumulator shared by event-driven hosts: beginFrame(), pointerMoved(x,y),
                    //   buttonDown/buttonUp(Button), wheel(dx,dy), pushNav(NavKey), pushKey(SpecialKey),
                    //   pushCodepoint(u21), pushText(utf8), pushUtf16Unit(u16), finish(resized,w,h) InputState
NavKey = enum { backspace, delete, left, right, up, down, home, end, page_up, page_down, enter, tab, escape, a, c, x, v, y, z }
resolveKey(NavKey, Modifiers) ?SpecialKey   // the one Shift/Ctrl policy every host shares (plain letters -> null)
input_queue         // module: platform/input_queue.zig
Clipboard = struct { ctx, read_fn, write_fn; pub fn read() []const u8; pub fn write(t) void }
ImeState = struct { active: bool = false, text: []const u8 = "", cursor: usize = 0 }
FileDialogResult = ?[]const u8
FileDialogFilter = struct { name: []const u8 = "All files", pattern: []const u8 = "*.*" }
FileDialogPoll = union(enum) { pending, ok: []const u8, cancelled }
validateHost(comptime T: type) void   // comptime contract: deinit, pollInputs, shouldClose,
                                       //   nativeHandle, textMeasurer, clipboard, imeState,
                                       //   publishA11yTree, open/save/request/pollFileDialog,
                                       //   secondary-window decls, setTitle, nowMs (scaleFactor optional)
```

### Gpu interface (`teak.gpu` → gpu/context.zig)
Backends live in `gpu/{native,native_linux,web}.zig` — picked by the build under
`teak-gpu-native`.
```zig
ClearColor = [4]f32
InitOptions = struct { msaa: bool = false /* 4x main UI pass */, scene_msaa: bool = true }
                                       // backends: Gpu.init(handle, w, h) | Gpu.initWithOptions(handle, w, h, InitOptions)
validateGpu(comptime T: type) void    // comptime contract: deinit, resize, uploadVertices,
                                       //   renderFrame, rasterizeText, uploadText, uploadImage, uploadImages, releaseImage
// Optional extension (checked only when present; the scene trio is all-or-none):
//   uploadMesh(*Gpu, MeshData) MeshHandle      releaseMesh(*Gpu, MeshHandle) void
//   renderScenes(*Gpu, []const SceneDraw, []const SceneItem) void  // before renderFrame; offscreen 3D -> composite quads
//   setOverlayStart(*Gpu, OverlaySplit) void    // before the uploads: draw base solids/images/scenes/text, THEN
//                                              //   the overlay's, so an opaque overlay hides base text (hatch 5)
```

### Headless runs (`teak.headless` → headless_run.zig; docs/features/headless.md)
No display needed; Linux + a Vulkan device. In build.zig: `teak.linkHeadless(b, exe, .{})` adds imports
`teak-platform-headless` (`Host`: scripted input, fake 16 ms/frame clock, stb text, captured effects) and
`teak-gpu-headless` (`Gpu.initOffscreen(w,h,InitOptions)`, `Gpu.readFrame(alloc) ![]u8` RGBA8).
```zig
Step = union(enum) { frames: u32, move: [2]f32, down, up: Button, wheel: [2]f32, chars: []const u8,
                     key: SpecialKey, mods: Modifiers, click: [2]f32, drag: [2][2]f32 }
headless.play(rt: anytype, host: anytype, steps: []const Step) !void
headless.shot(App, Host, Gpu, gpa, path, ShotOptions{ width, height, msaa, steps, settle, run }) !void  // script -> PNG
headless.writeFramePng(gpu, gpa, path) !void;  encodePng(gpa, rgba, w, h) ![]u8;  pathArg(init, default) []const u8
// Host: pushMouseMove/Down/Up, pushWheel, pushChars, pushKey, setModifiers, close, injectEffectResult(EffectResult),
//       submittedEffects() []const Captured{kind,id,name,bytes,mime,method}, countEffects(kind), clearSubmittedEffects()
```

### Application loop (`teak.run` / `teak.runtime` → run.zig)
```zig
run(comptime App: type, gpa, host: anytype, gpu: anytype, opts: RunOptions) !void
Runtime(comptime App: type, comptime Host: type, comptime Gpu: type) type
    // the loop body `run` is built on, for hosts that own the loop (web rAF):
    //   Runtime.init(gpa, *Host, *Gpu, RunOptions) !Runtime   (keep it in one place; don't move it)
    //   rt.frame() !void   // ONE iteration: poll, route, subs, view, layout, render
    //   rt.deinit()
    // run == init + `while (!host.shouldClose()) try rt.frame()` + deinit.
RunOptions          // see "The App contract" above
SecondaryWindowSpec // see above
```

## Recipes

### Add a feature (4 steps)
1. `Model`: add a field for the new state.
2. `Msg`: add a variant for the new transition.
3. `update`: add the switch arm (compiler forces exhaustiveness).
4. `view`: emit the UI with `cb.*` calls.

### Add a widget (new Cmd variant)
1. Add a variant to `Cmd(Msg)` (core/cmd.zig) + its style/cmd struct.
2. Add a case in each pass: layout (measure+position), hit-test, render.
3. Add a convenience emitter method on `CmdBuffer`.
4. Extend `snapshot.zig`, `a11y.zig`, and `run.zig`'s `cmdsEqual` for it.
5. Map the new a11y `Role` in `platform/win32.zig` (`controlTypeForRole`,
   + `isFocusableRole` if interactive); `input/focus.zig`'s `isFocusable`
   if Tab-focusable; re-export in `src/teak.zig` + add to THIS file (the
   audit fails the build otherwise).

More worked examples and idioms: **docs/cookbook.md**.

## Testing story

- **Golden snapshot tests (headless, no Host/GPU).** view → layout with
  `teak.monoMeasurer()` → `teak.expectSnapshot(cmds, rects, opts, expected)`.
  The `[]Cmd`+`[]Rect`(+`TransientState`) triple fully describes a frame, so
  one text block asserts the whole screen: layout, labels, hover/press/focus
  markers (`.{ .transient = &ts }`), header (`.{ .header = ... }`). Output is
  deterministic and grep-able (one line per cmd, `tag (x,y,w,h) payload`).
- **`validateBalance(cmds)`** guards push/pop balance; `teak.run` calls it in
  Debug builds and panics with a named cmd index on an unbalanced buffer.
- **Live `TEAK_SNAPSHOT` streaming (implemented).** `teak.run` mirrors each
  changed frame's snapshot to a file — set `RunOptions.snapshot_path` or the
  `TEAK_SNAPSHOT` env var (env wins, read once at `run` start). Writes are
  atomic (`<path>.tmp` then rename) and change-gated (idle frames never touch
  disk); the header's `last_msg` names the transition that caused the change,
  including sub-fired Msgs. An agent driving a running app greps/diffs the
  file to "see" the GUI as data. See docs/features/snapshot.md.
- `zig build test` runs library tests from the repo root (no wgpu link).
- `zig build audit` runs the HARDLINE drift audit + wasm canary — including
  the rule that keeps THIS file in sync with `src/teak.zig` re-exports.

## Doc map

- `docs/HARDLINE.md` — the non-negotiable rules (§1 invariants, §2 hatches,
  §3 forbidden, §5 audit). Read before any design-touching change.
- `spec.md` — full architecture specification.
- `docs/consuming-teak.md` — consumer onboarding: build.zig.zon → working app.
- `docs/cookbook.md` — worked recipes/idioms for building on Teak.
- `docs/pitfalls.md` — common traps.
- `docs/features/run.md` — `teak.run` loop + optional App hooks + secondary window.
- `docs/features/subscriptions.md` — declarative timers (`Sub`/`subscribe`); `run` wiring.
- `docs/features/widgets.md` — disabled state, NumericField, Dropdown, Combobox, setTitle, and the primitive-built widgets (toggle, progress, tabs, split pane, tooltip, toast, dialog, menu bar, context menu).
- `docs/features/components.md` — comptime component composition.
- `docs/features/canvas.md` — charts & custom 2D drawing (+ triangle/line batches).
- `docs/features/scene3d.md` — 3D meshes in the UI, `resources()` hook, Gpu scene extension.
- `docs/features/tables.md` — fixed-column monospace tables (`teak.table`).
- `docs/features/layout.md` — layout engine (measure + position passes).
- `docs/features/hit-test.md` — hit-test + hover-test.
- `docs/features/focus.md` — Msg-keyed stable focus traversal.
- `docs/features/transient-state.md` — presentation-only state.
- `docs/features/text.md` — TextMeasurer + FontSpec.
- `docs/features/host.md` — Host interface (window + input; DPI/scaling notes).
- `docs/features/headless.md` — headless native runs: scripted input -> PNG (`linkHeadless`, `teak.headless`).
- `docs/features/gpu.md` — Gpu interface (vertex upload + present).
- `docs/features/snapshot.md` — golden snapshot tests + live TEAK_SNAPSHOT streaming.
- `docs/features/functional-gaps.md` — overlay, image, selection/clipboard,
  subs, multi-window/dialogs, virtual list, a11y, rich text.
- `docs/features/ergonomic-helpers.md` — Theme, mixedText, sliderDrag, TextField
  key dispatch, form rows, ComponentList, debug overlay.

## Build & consume

Requires **Zig 0.17.0+**. Teak is a pure library (no external deps); wgpu-native
prebuilts are lazy deps fetched only on native/web UI builds.

`build.zig.zon`:
```zig
.dependencies = .{
    .teak = .{
        .url = "git+https://github.com/hotschmoe/teak.git#<commit>",
        .hash = "...",   // zig fetch --save fills this in
    },
},
```

`build.zig` wiring (module + native UI):
```zig
const teak = @import("teak");            // teak's build.zig is importable
const teak_dep = b.dependency("teak", .{ .target = target, .optimize = optimize });
// pure-logic module:  teak_dep.module("teak")
// native UI (gated on backend availability):
if (teak.hasNativeBackend(target.result.os.tag)) {
    // ...addExecutable(src/ui_main.zig)...
    teak.linkNativeWgpu(b, ui, .{});     // Win32 (GDI) or X11 (stb_truetype) + wgpu, per OS
}
// web: teak.linkWebWgpu(b, exe, .{})    // wasm + WebGPU (zunk)
```
`ui_main.zig` imports `teak-platform-native` + `teak-gpu-native`, inits
`Host`/`Gpu`, and calls `teak.run(App, gpa, &host, &gpu, .{})`.

Per-OS notes: **Windows** = Win32 window + GDI text; **Linux** = X11 (libX11
`dlopen`ed at runtime — no dev package; needs libX11.so.6 + a Vulkan driver +
a monospace TTF, `TEAK_FONT` to override); Wayland via XWayland. **Web** =
wasm + WebGPU. Windows-ARM64 hosts use the native
aarch64-windows Zig 0.17 toolchain with no extra flags (cross-compile with
`-Dtarget=aarch64-windows-gnu` from other hosts).
